description:
Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with stunning landscapes, intricate platforms, and mysterious mechanisms. Use your skills to dodge traps, solve puzzles, and uncover treasures hidden among the clouds.

Beautiful Visuals: Handcrafted levels inspired by fantastical worlds.
Engaging Gameplay: A perfect mix of agility, strategy, and exploration.
Unique Challenges: Face dynamic traps and solve mind-bending puzzles.
Discover Secrets: Find hidden gems and unravel the mystery of the floating realms.

Designed for fans of classic platformers and those who love enchanting, magical worlds. Can you escape and reveal all the secrets? Bright Escape awaits!
name: Bright Escape
intro: Embark on a magical journey in Bright Escape!
